name: WayriCAD Review
description: Message-style KiCad reviews with GitHub/GitLab comments and threaded GitHub Discussions.
description_full: Read individual engineering message cards, reply inline, search and highlight authors, and attach saved-revision PCB object/region context. Comments uses GitHub/GitLab general issue/PR/MR conversations; Discussions uses real GitHub GraphQL discussion threads. Confirmed GitLab screenshots share KiView attachment metadata; GitHub attachments use its browser editor. Published comments and anchors remain provider-owned. Local storage is an optional cache and separate drafts. Native schematic selection, overlays and inline diff reviews are unsupported. Testing package; see the native validation scope and remaining platform limits.
